run_retrieve_rerank: run the retrieve_rerank script to execute retrieval and ranking on evaluation datasets via Hydra config
apply_ranker: apply a ranker to validate, preprocess, shard, and run retrieval queries across evaluation datasets
generate_output_file_name: generate an output file path from an output folder and dataset file with an optional suffix
setup_logger: setup a logger with INFO level and a console handler using a formatted timestamp and thread name
run_main: run the main entry point to instantiate a retriever from config, shard queries, and save prediction outputs
